content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is a self-hosted digital commerce stack designed for creators who sell music, beats, or plugins. It replaces platforms like Gumroad or PayPal with open infrastructure. The core components are free: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges just 0.5% per transaction. Unlike platforms that lock you in or charge 10%, this stack gives you full ownership. You control the code, the data, and the deployment. It’s built to work in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted or unreliable. The system automates file delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain, ensuring a seamless experience for buyers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in three layers: hosting, backend, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed. The backend logic—order processing, file delivery, and payment verification—runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your preference. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, converting the transaction to USD at the time of purchase. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your backend. The backend verifies the payment, logs the order, and delivers the file via a secure link. The entire process is automated, with no manual intervention required. The system is designed to scale with your business, handling thousands of transactions without additional fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell music, beats, plugins, or other digital products and need a reliable way to accept payments and deliver files, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. By using this stack, you avoid platform fees, payment rejections, and data lock-in. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad (10%) to NOWPayments (0.5%) retains $921 more in revenue. This system is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. It’s not just a technical solution—it’s a way to reclaim your sovereignty as a creator.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—95% less than Gumroad’s 10% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides fast, free hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, ensuring payments are verified and files are delivered securely. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data, keeping it accessible and organized. NOWPayments processes crypto payments, offering 300+ currencies and a 0.5% fee. File delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast, reliable access for buyers. The system is modular, meaning you can swap components as needed. For example, if you prefer not to use Google services, you can replace Google Sheets with Supabase and Google Drive with Cloudflare R2. The stack is designed to be flexible, scalable, and fully under your control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting and backend tools. GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script are the simplest combination, while Cloudflare Pages and Workers offer more advanced features. Set up NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, selecting low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. Configure your backend to listen for NOWPayments webhooks and automate file delivery. Load your products into the system, ensuring each has a secure download link. Test the entire flow end-to-end before going live. If you’re new to this, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing everything you need to deploy and scale your stack. It’s an instant download, worth $348 separately, and available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. With this knowledge, you can build a commerce system that works anywhere, for anyone.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This system automates payment verification and file delivery, ensuring a seamless experience for buyers. By avoiding platforms like Gumroad, you retain more revenue—switching from 10% fees to 0.5% saves $921 on 100 sales of a $97 product. The stack is designed to work in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted, giving you full control over your infrastructure.
The stack is modular: swap components like Supabase for Google Sheets as needed.

If you’re looking to sell notion templates, fonts, or software using USDT or Bitcoin, the principles here apply. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing everything you need to deploy a crypto-only digital download store. It’s available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this stack ensures you own your infrastructure and keep more of your earnings.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend: Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Configure NOWPayments for crypto transactions, selecting low-fee networks like BSC or Solana. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Load your products into the system, ensuring each has a secure download link. Test the entire flow end-to-end before going live. Deploy your stack and start selling. Monitor transactions via NOWPayments and your order storage system. Scale as needed by adding more products or optimizing your backend.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints and templates that require no coding. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy your stack.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and Ethereum. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How do I handle refunds in this system?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the buyer’s wallet. The system logs all transactions for easy reference.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This stack is designed for digital products like music, ebooks, and templates. Physical products require additional logistics not covered here.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The system is designed to retry payment verification. If NOWPayments is unavailable, transactions will queue and process once the service is restored.
